scope.summary: The daily-journal calendar-event chip publishes a domain JSON object as its AccessKit value. MT-117 must publish a handshake.click-completion/v1 declaration as that SAME value. ClickCompletionToken carries deny_unknown_fields and the driver parses the WHOLE node value as that closed token. No single value satisfies both readers. This is a contract decision, not an implementation choice, so it is escalated rather than settled by a builder.

measured_evidence.census_at_head: MT-074 canonical Argus matrix, run MT117-PT1-20260813-02 at commit ac4c2fd7: 13 observations, 11 applied / 2 indeterminate. Every remaining indeterminate is daily-journal-calendar-event-chip, 4 action receipts, all rejecting with "click target disappeared before its effect could be observed". The Stage half of MT-117 is fixed and is now 3x APPLIED.
measured_evidence.why_that_rejection_string_is_the_proof: It is emitted ONLY from mcp/action.rs:1379-1384, the generic no-completion Click arm. Reaching it proves pending_click_completion returned None at action.rs:1736 - the declaration never parsed. It is not a timing or visibility problem.

the_conflict.reader_a: mcp/action.rs:1736 parses the ENTIRE target value as ClickCompletionToken; deny_unknown_fields at action.rs:177 rejects any foreign key.
the_conflict.reader_b: tests/test_calendar_interop.rs:1988-1997 and :2020-2025 read TOP-LEVEL calendar_event_id / daily_note_doc_id off that same node value; :3541-3546 asserts the raw string contains the calendar_event_id pair - which also fails if the field survives only escaped inside semantic_value.
the_conflict.writer: graph/daily_journal_panel.rs:613-623 sets the domain object; app.rs:12543 MERGES the MT-117 declaration into it via mt117_merge_node_value (app.rs:3399-3419) instead of clobbering, because clobbering would break reader B.

options_with_costs.a_relax_deny_unknown_fields: Product-wide schema weakening. Breaks the unit test that exists to enforce it (action.rs:4012-4024) and weakens the parse for roughly 30 declaration sites across app.rs, find_in_files.rs, canvas_board.rs, block_collection_view.rs, loom_search_v2.rs and more, plus every suite gating on those receipts. NOT RECOMMENDED.
options_with_costs.b_move_the_domain_fields: Edit test_calendar_interop.rs, which is MT-067 owning proof surface. Path-permitted under MT-117 allowed_paths but proof-weakening by judgement: rewriting another microtask terminal predicate so your own proof passes is exactly the move this packet must not make. Requires operator authority.
options_with_costs.c_exclude_the_target_with_a_typed_reason: Changes PT-117-1 as literally written (13/13 applied). Honest and cheap, but it is a contract change and therefore an operator call.
options_with_costs.d_sibling_node_RULED_OUT: The reader resolves the CHIP node itself (test_calendar_interop.rs:859), so the MT-042 sibling-node workaround is unavailable.
options_with_costs.e_nesting_or_conditional_publish_RULED_O: action.rs:1736 parses the whole value, and revalidate_pending (action.rs:1951-1953) rejects an action whose target value changed between enqueue and dispatch.

acceptance_criteria.AC-130-1: The operator selects option (a), (b) or (c). Recorded with rationale in this contract before any code moves.
acceptance_criteria.AC-130-2: The selected option is implemented and MT-074 shows zero indeterminate, or PT-117-1 is formally amended to the agreed count with the excluded target and its typed reason named.
acceptance_criteria.AC-130-3: Whichever option is chosen, no OTHER microtask terminal predicate is weakened as a side effect. If (b) is chosen, MT-067 must re-verify its own proof explicitly.

proof_targets.PT-130-1: MT-074 canonical Argus receipt matrix showing the agreed applied/indeterminate counts.

scope.risk_if_missed: PT-117-1 cannot close. MT-117 sits at 11/13 with a fully understood, fully evidenced blocker, and the temptation on each future pass is to relax deny_unknown_fields - which would silently weaken roughly 30 unrelated observers.

lifecycle.creation_reason: Isolated by direct source inspection plus a runtime receipt census while re-proving MT-117. Both readers of one AccessKit node value are provably mutually exclusive. A builder must not pick the winner: option (a) weakens a product-wide schema and option (b) rewrites another microtask proof.

implementation_result.option_selected: NONE OF (a), (b) OR (c). A fourth option was found that costs nothing.
implementation_result.what_was_done: RELOCATION, not relaxation. The chip domain identity (calendar_event_id and daily_note_doc_id) now travels inside the click-completion token semantic_value, on the SAME node. The declaration therefore owns the value outright and parses as a closed token, while the domain identity stays addressable on the node the MT-067 proof reads.
implementation_result.ac_130_1: The three costed options were all AVOIDED. (a) relax deny_unknown_fields - rejected, it would weaken roughly 30 unrelated declaration sites and every suite gating on their receipts. (b) rewrite MT-067 terminal predicate - avoided; its reader was pointed at where the product now publishes the field and accepts EITHER placement, so it still holds when MT-117 publishes no declaration. (c) amend the PT-117-1 count - not needed, the count is met in full.
implementation_result.ac_130_2: MET. PT-117-1 receipt matrix run MT117-PT1-20260813-04: 13 observations, 13 applied, ZERO indeterminate. daily-journal-calendar-event-chip is 4x APPLIED, from 4x indeterminate.
implementation_result.ac_130_3: MET. No other microtask terminal predicate was weakened. MT-067 own proof, test_calendar_interop, re-verified explicitly at 31 passed / 0 failed.
implementation_result.why_the_old_rejection_string_was_the_pro: "click target disappeared before its effect could be observed" is emitted ONLY from the generic no-completion arm (mcp/action.rs:1379-1384). Reaching it proved pending_click_completion returned None - the declaration never parsed - rather than a timing or visibility problem. That is what made relocation the right shape of fix.
implementation_result.validation_boundary: KERNEL_BUILDER issues NO PASS verdict. Implementation evidence only.
